articles.title: Rising govt spending, export demand give Indian defence cos ₹15trn runway
articles.summary: Five major Indian defence firms, including Hindustan Aeronautics, Bharat Electronics, Bharat Dynamics, Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders, and Larsen & Toubro's Precision Engineering & System, are reportedly receiving a significant 'windfall'. This likely indicates substantial new contracts, funding, or orders, aiming to bolster India's indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities. Such a distribution among key defence players would significantly contribute to national security and sector growth.
